plan.supervision: Common forward-only e→a/e→b supervision; no inverse assumption for irreversible differentiation. All conditions share correct native CE/KD and generator-output KD, exact1024 anchors each epoch, and five native state queries. Only geometric pairing or geometry-space choice differs.
plan.output_space_scope: Information diagnostic; same encoder/native supervision/input exposures/epochs, smaller operators on full logits; operator parameter counts differ. It is not a capacity-matched causal control.
plan.legacy_permworld_scope: Completed PermWorld studies use bidirectional involution supervision and a transformer. They are version1, preserved as-is; not described as identical architecture/loss to new forward-only noninvertible-compatible version3.
plan.test_opening: After fixed900-epoch pilot passes known native/gen thresholds, finish all36 formal fits before evaluating compound test. No use of compound results for tuning or early stopping. Fixed900 epoch shared across both new domains.
plan.matrix_actions: A=[[0,1],[1,0]], B=[[0,-1],[1,-1]] inGL(2,F13); generated group has6 elements, A²=B³=e andABA=B². Ordinary task trace.
plan.polynomial_actions: Exact degree3 polynomials overF13; A translates by+1, B differentiates. AB=BA. Base/readout f(0), observed f(0),f(1),f′(0), missing f′(1).
plan.polynomial_splitting: Blocks by(c3, derivative discriminant) retain translation closure and one derivative. Audit all actually observed known paths against all test paths. Full semigroup-closure disjointness is impossible because D⁴ sends all cubics tozero. Collision/uncertainty block dependence must be reported.
plan.source_replication: Three independently pretrained sources per domain, reused in six adaptation repeats. Supports may overlap; source/train/validation/test path separation is audited.
plan.scope: Intervention study of specified mathematical relations; not spontaneous discovery, full group representation proof, or established output-independent mechanism.
plan.encoding: numeric_gelu: four centered/scaled scalar field coordinates, generic GELU MLP; no one-hot features and no group operations in the model.
plan.known_only_selection: Version2 one-hot/numeric encoding failed generator generalization (train99.8%, heldout7.8%). Scalar GELU selected before compound tests using separately reserved known pilot64 and confirmation128. No compound outcomes used for architecture selection. Polynomial shares matrix-selected architecture.
plan.execution: Two independent seeded fit processes; every36 fixed900-epoch fit completes before compound test opens.
plan.registration_scope: Registered after known-only source0/pilot architecture feasibility, before every new compound test and before all36 formal intervention fits. Source0/pilot reused exactly; three ordinary source seeds, six adaptations.
